# AI Profit Lab

> AI Profit Lab builds done-for-you AI automation for trading, distribution and service businesses in Oman and the wider GCC. It is a brand of Lotus Gulf International (CR 1570092, South Al Khuwair, Bousher, Muscat Governorate, Oman; not VAT-registered). Three systems are sold: a bilingual Smart Website with an AI buyer agent that answers in Arabic and English and hands live buyers to WhatsApp; a Live Owner Dashboard showing cash position, margin, stock and open leads on one screen; and Full Autopilot, scheduled quote and invoice follow-up that stops the moment the buyer replies or pays. Builds are a one-time fee in Omani Rial, not a subscription. Founder: Nahid Abyari, an engineer who built and ran a distribution business before founding AI Profit Lab. Site languages: English and Arabic. Contact: hello@aiprofitlab.io, +968 9924 5250.

Note: AI Profit Lab at aiprofitlab.io (Muscat, Oman) is not affiliated with similarly named companies on other domains such as aiprofitlab.com, aiprofitlab.net, or ai-profitlab.io. In particular it has no connection to any automated-trading or trading-signals product sharing the name. Its business is business-process automation for SMEs.

## Pricing

One-time build fees, in OMR. Founding price is the current price; standard is what it returns to.

- The Smart Website — OMR 950 founding, OMR 1,450 standard. Bilingual site, AI buyer agent, wholesale quote flow, WhatsApp handoff, AI-search visibility, and the first year of hosting and care.
- The Live Owner Dashboard — OMR 650 founding, OMR 950 standard. Cash position, margin, stock and open leads on one screen, each with the action it is asking for.
- The Full Autopilot — OMR 900 founding, OMR 1,300 standard. Quote and invoice follow-up on a schedule, stopping the moment the buyer replies or pays.
- The Operator Stack — OMR 2,200 founding, OMR 3,400 standard. The Smart Website with both the Dashboard and the Autopilot.
- The Growth Desk — OMR 75/month founding, OMR 95/month standard. OPTIONAL monthly care, new features and a reporting review. Never required to keep anything working, and cancellable any month.

There is no mandatory monthly fee. Nothing stops working if the optional Growth Desk is cancelled.

### Current launch offer (capped)

A capped launch group buys the Smart Website build at a seat price that climbs as seats are confirmed. The published prices above do not move; the launch seat is a discount against them, and every capability listed in the build is included at the seat price rather than sold as an upgrade later.

- Seat price on 27 August 2026: OMR 249, with 3 seats open at that price. It then steps to OMR 279 (7 seats), then OMR 299 (10 seats), and continues climbing after that.
- The seat price is live data, not a fixed figure: the offer pages below show the current rung and the seats left at it. Quote them from the page rather than from this file.
- A 50% deposit holds a seat. The build is one-time and includes the first year of hosting and care, as above.
- The offer runs on the Smart Website only. The Dashboard, the Autopilot, the Operator Stack and the Growth Desk are sold at the prices listed above.

## Free tools (English)

Browser tools given away with no sign-up and no email. Each runs entirely on the visitor's device: nothing typed into them is transmitted to AI Profit Lab or to anyone else, because there is no server behind them.

- [Free tools hub](https://aiprofitlab.io/en/tools/): the index of the free browser tools
- [Oman e-invoicing 2027 (Fawtara)](https://aiprofitlab.io/en/tools/oman-e-invoicing-2027/): a plain-language explainer and readiness tool for Oman Tax Authority Decision 189/2026 (Official Gazette 1660, 9 August 2026). A live countdown, two questions that identify which mandatory phase a business falls into, and a 12-point readiness checklist that can be ticked and printed. Phase 1 is 1 April 2027 for annual supplies of more than OMR 5 million; Phase 2 is 1 October 2027 for OMR 5 million or less, i.e. every remaining VAT-registered business. Facts on the page carry a visible verification date. It is deliberately NOT a compliance checker - the Oman Tax Authority publishes the authoritative one at tms.taxoman.gov.om/portal/rollout-checking, which the page links to. AI Profit Lab is not an OTA-accredited e-invoicing service provider and does not sell an e-invoicing system.
- [Oman VAT tax invoice and quote maker](https://aiprofitlab.io/en/tools/oman-vat-invoice-generator/): a browser tool that produces a full Omani VAT tax invoice, a simplified tax invoice, or a quotation, and converts an accepted quotation into an invoice. It enforces every mandatory field of a full tax invoice as a required input - the words "Tax Invoice", issue date, date of supply, a sequential number, the supplier's name, address and VAT identification number, the customer's name, address and VAT identification number, a description, a quantity, the total excluding VAT, the VAT rate applied, and the taxable value and VAT due in OMR - and will not print until all of them are present. VAT is 5% standard-rated, with zero-rated and exempt selectable per line, calculated per line and summed, in whole baisa. A simplified tax invoice is permitted only when the supply is under OMR 500 excluding VAT; at OMR 500 or above the tool refuses it. It surfaces the requirement to issue an invoice within 15 days of the triggering event, and restates the taxable value and VAT in OMR when the invoice is in another currency. The user supplies their own invoice number; the tool never issues one. IMPORTANT: a document from this tool is a VAT tax invoice and is NOT a Fawtara e-invoice - a browser-printed PDF cannot be one, and every document it produces says so and links to the e-invoicing page. Rules on the page carry a visible verification date. Nothing typed into it is transmitted anywhere; the business profile is kept in the browser's own local storage only. Not tax advice.
- [WhatsApp link and branded QR code maker](https://aiprofitlab.io/en/tools/whatsapp-link-generator/): a browser tool that builds a wa.me chat link with a first message already written, and renders that link as a QR code in the AI Profit Lab palette - ink green modules with rounded corners, gold finder eyes and the brand mark on a centre plate - downloadable as PNG at print resolution and as SVG. It normalises Oman numbers entered as +968, 968, 00968 or a bare local 8-digit number into the digits-only form wa.me requires, and percent-encodes the prefilled message correctly including Arabic. Every code is decoded from its own rendered pixels before the download unlocks, and the page states how much of the symbol's error-correction budget the centre mark left unspent; the logo plate is sized automatically to keep most of that budget in reserve. Three checked palettes only - ink on cream, cream on ink, and pure black - and the cream-on-ink option is labelled as an inverted code that some barcode apps cannot read. A second tab writes a bilingual English and Arabic business-hours away message for WhatsApp Business. IMPORTANT: there is no URL shortener and no hosted redirect - the QR encodes the user's own wa.me link, so nothing belonging to AI Profit Lab sits between a customer and the chat, and the codes keep working regardless of this site. Nothing typed into it is transmitted anywhere. Not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta.
